name: – Andrzej Halicki – After § 25 – Am 22
title: REPORT on general guidelines for the preparation of the 2026 budget, Section III – Commission
part_text: 25a. Calls for the full and urgent implementation of the Agreement establishing an interinstitutional body for ethical standards for members of institutions and advisory bodies referred to in Article 13 of the Treaty on European Union; believes that the Huawei corruption scandal adds special urgency to starting the work of the body without delay; commits to providing the necessary financial and human resources to allow the body to fulfil its mandate and implement its tasks properly;
